newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Three die as Colombian rebels destroy police HQ.
newsitem.headline: Three die as Colombian rebels destroy police HQ.

text.p: One policeman and two civilians died when leftist rebels attacked a police headquarters in northern Colombia, officials said on Thursday.

About 40 guerrillas of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC), the country's largest insurgent force, stormed the building in the village of San Cayayetano, in Bolivar province, at 3:30 pm on Wednesday (2030 GMT), police said.
One of the dead civilians was a cattle rancher, the other a businessman. The police headquarters was destroyed in the attack, a police spokesman said.
